title: Keep verified Evolution journal counts visible on partial reads

root_cause.summary: In GET /bff/management/evolution-journal?view=history, the BFF returned 200 OK with 6 real history rows (3 mutation_review, 3 evolution_decision), 2530 auto-proposal counts from healthy evolution_decisions and postmortems surfaces (incident_followup=433, incident_severity=9, postmortem_draft=2088), while ancillary surfaces freeze_orders and rollbacks reported status='unavailable' and management_evolution_journal reported status='degraded'. EvolutionJournalPage in src/management/pages/oversight/_core.tsx computed isReadFailed = Boolean(error) || (!loading && data === undefined && !isFleetSummary) || degradedSurfaces.length > 0, treating any degraded ancillary surface as a whole-page read failure and hiding evolution-auto-proposals-summary (the 2530 auto-proposal counters and evolution-view-toggle), evolution-journal-summary (including evolution-active-view-badge), and evolution-journal-pager. In addition, adaptEvolutionJournalList in src/lib/bff-v1/management.ts and EvolutionJournalPage rendered summary.rollback_count (0) and summary.freeze_order_count (0) as numeric 0 even when meta.surfaces.rollbacks and meta.surfaces.freeze_orders were unavailable.

delivered: Updated adaptEvolutionJournalList and ManagementEvolutionJournalSummary in src/lib/bff-v1/management.ts to evaluate meta.surfaces before summary counts and map per-surface summary counts (decision_count, mutation_review_count, pending_review_count, postmortem_count, rollback_count, completed_rollback_count, freeze_order_count, active_freeze_count) to null whenever their backing surface status is degraded/unavailable/error/failed/unknown, preventing unavailable freeze_orders or rollbacks from masquerading as owner zero.

Updated EvolutionJournalPage in src/management/pages/oversight/_core.tsx to separate whole-page transport/missing-data failure (isReadFailed) from surface degradation (hasDegradedSurfaces), keeping evolution-auto-proposals-summary (with the 2530 healthy-source counters and evolution-view-toggle), evolution-journal-summary (with evolution-active-view-badge, evolution-partial-read-badge, and per-source summary counts), the 6 journal rows, and evolution-journal-pager visible on partial reads while still rendering the evolution-journal-degraded alert and suppressing the empty-history message when any surface is degraded.

Formatted per-source summary counts and auto-proposal counters in EvolutionJournalPage via formatJournalSurfaceCount so healthy surfaces render their verified counts (Decisions: 3, Mutation reviews: 3, Postmortems: 0, Auto proposals: 2530) while unavailable surfaces render honest unknown status labels ('unknown (unavailable)' / '未知 (unavailable)') instead of 0.

Added symmetric en-US and zh-TW locale keys (summarySourceUnknown, summarySourceUnknownFmt, partialReadBadge, partialReadBody) under mgmt.evolution in src/i18n/locales/en-US.ts and src/i18n/locales/zh-TW.ts and registered them in src/lib/v5/management/__tests__/i18nParity.test.ts.

Added unit and component tests in src/lib/bff-v1/__tests__/management.test.ts and src/management/pages/oversight/EvolutionJournalPage.test.tsx covering the exact captured 00:06 partial-read payload and DOM expectations across zh-TW and en-US.
not_changing: Pantheon BFF / owner services (accepted live BFF commit 0cd59ab286b7ad4d7c742993215cb39919cce580 is unchanged).
No deployment or business write actions.
